from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollmentData(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment data extracted from a single university's Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="Name of the university")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Academic term or year the data covers (e.g., 'Fall 2021')")
    transfer_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Enrolled degree-seeking transfer students (Section D2)")
    first_time_first_year_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Enrolled degree-seeking first-time, first-year students (Section C1/B1)")
    other_first_year_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Enrolled degree-seeking 'other first-year' students (Section B2), if reported separately")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityEnrollmentData]
